title: Dependency Chain Auto Refresh
problem: Child workflows can retain stale hard-coded parent blob pins after an upstream step changes, causing later steps to fail for bookkeeping drift instead of real incompatibility.
root_cause: Parent identity was encoded as literal blob constants and parent paths were absent from child workflow triggers.
patch: Register parent paths once, dynamically resolve base/head parent blobs on every proof, wake the child workflow on parent changes, and run child compatibility contracts against the current parent identity.
